narration.text: Forty days later Noah did something small and brave. He opened the window. And what he sent out first was a raven.
And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
It flew back and forth over the water, and it never came home. No answer. No news. Only the sound of wings, and then silence.
